messages:
anna: Quick heads up 44 - my partner's parent had a medical emergency so we're flying out. I need to take parental/partner leave to help with childcare when we return. Can I start a continuous block asap or do I need advance notice?

mike: Oh no, hope they're ok. For parental/partner leave we prefer 30 days notice but we understand emergencies. You can request an emergency start — submit the request and whatever docs you have, and People Ops will backdate if needed.

priya: Hi Anna FYI benefits: paid parental top-up applies to primary caregivers for up to 12 weeks. If you're secondary caregiver, you get 6 weeks of company top-up. We can discuss classification during intake.

anna: I expect to be primary caregiver for the first 3 weeks, then taper to part-time for 2 weeks. Is partial pay pro-rated?

mike: Yes, partial-week pay is pro-rated by scheduled FTE. If you go 0.6FTE for two weeks, top-up will calculate on that basis. Need manager approval for FTE change in Workday.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: Payroll cutoff for next pay cycle is 2026-04-10 11:59pm PT. Upload docs to leave-requests@redwood.com or Workday before cutoff to affect next payroll.

anna: What docs do I upload for emergency start? We don't have a hospital discharge yet but have flight receipts and a note from my partner.

priya: For emergency starts we accept: 1) a brief written statement from the family member or partner, 2) any supporting document (hospital admit/discharge, travel receipts), and 3) the completed HCP form when available. Upload what you have and update when more docs arrive.

mike: Manager side: I approve the temporary 0.6FTE for Anna starting 2026-04-05 through 2026-04-18, then intermittent 3 days/week for the next 2 weeks. I'll reassign sprint duties and pair Anna with Raj for on-call.

anna: Thanks! One more Q 1: does the childcare backup stipend cover travel-related childcare costs (airport daycare) while we're in transit?

priya: Usually the stipend covers emergency/backup childcare on a per-session basis; travel daycare can be approved as an exception if you submit receipts and justification. I recommend saving receipts and we can pre-approve if you DM me.

peopleops-bot: Ticket created: LEAVE-3401 assigned to priya. Status: docs-pending.

anna: Uploaded partner note + flight itinerary. Will add HCP when available. Appreciate the quick responses.
